project.description: Pull the provided studies data into the local workspace. The directory will be the lowercase study abbreviation. Useful for exploring the folders and files.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: study_abbr
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: The study abbreviation. Examples: ACTIV4a, COVID19_C4R_CARDIA

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
### assume etl role aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
#study_abbr="COVID19_C4R_CARDIA" #aws s3 cp --recursive "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abbr,,}" "./${study_abbr,,}"
#study_abbr="activ4a" #aws s3 cp --recursive "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abbr,,}" "./${study_abbr,,}"
aws s3 cp --recursive "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abbr,,}" "./${study_abbr,,}" #aws s3 cp "./${study_abbr,,}/decoded_data/${study_abbr}_metadata.json" "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abbr,,}/decoded_data/${study_abbr,,}_metadata.json"
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
